item.title: CVE-2026-124034, CVE-2026-124035: Issues with Amazon Braket SDK
item.description: [Cloud] AWS Security: Bulletin ID: 2026-175-AWS Publication Date: 11/09/2026 14:15 PM PST Description: Amazon Braket SDK is an open source Python library that customers use to run quantum tasks and hybrid jobs on Amazon Braket. We identified CVE-2026-124034, an issue in the local hybrid job input data download in the Amazon Braket SDK. And we identified CVE-2026-124035, an issue in the error mitigation schema validation in Amazon Braket Schemas, the library the Amazon Braket SDK uses to parse quantum task results. Impacted versions: - amazon-braket-sdk >= 1.10.0 AND < 1.127.7 - amazon-braket-schemas >= 1.17.0 AND < 1.32.2 Refer to the article for the most up-to-date and complete information. Read this article

item.title: CVE-2026-124033 - Relative path traversal in the log export commands in AWS ParallelCluster CLI
item.description: [Cloud] AWS Security: Bulletin ID: 2026-174-AWS Publication Date: 11/09/2026 13:00 PM PST Description: AWS ParallelCluster CLI is an open source command line tool, distributed on PyPI as aws-parallelcluster. We identified CVE-2026-124033, an issue where the export-cluster-logs and export-image-logs commands in the AWS ParallelCluster CLI before version 3.16.0 contain a relative path traversal issue. An authenticated remote user with write access to the log export Amazon S3 bucket could use a crafted S3 object key to write files outside the intended export directory on the machine running the command. item.title: CISA Adds Four Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
item.description: [Security] CISA Advisories: CISA has added four new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog , based on evidence of active exploitation. CVE-2026-102895 GPUStack Improper Authentication Vulnerability CVE-2026-116779 SignalWire FreeSwitch Code Injection Vulnerability CVE-2026-123158 OpenBSD OpenSSH Unexpected Status Code or Return Value Vulnerability CVE-2026-123218 IBM Aspera Faspex Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability These types of vulnerabilities are a frequent attack vector for malicious cyber actors and pose significant risks to the federal enterprise. Binding Operational Directive (BOD) 26-04: Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk establishes vulnerability management requirement

item.title: CVE-2026-122266 - Improper isolation of shared resources in aws-network-policy-agent in Amazon EKS
item.description: [Cloud] AWS Security: Bulletin ID: 2026-170-AWS Publication Date: 11/04/2026 13:30 PM PST Description: We identified CVE-2026-122266, an issue in Amazon EKS Network Policy Agent (aws-network-policy-agent). Improper isolation of shared eBPF connection tracking state might allow an authenticated adjacent user to bypass NetworkPolicy ingress enforcement on co-located pods. Impacted versions: - aws-network-policy-agent < 1.3.7 - Amazon VPC CNI Managed Add-on < 1.22.3 Refer to the article below for the most up-to-date and complete information. Read this article

item.title: CVE-2026-122192 - Guest Access to Firecracker Process Memory After a Failed Memory Discard
item.description: [Cloud] AWS Security: Bulletin ID: 2026-169-AWS Publication Date: 11/04/2026 11:30 AM PST Description: We identified CVE-2026-122192, an issue in Firecracker v0.23.0 through v1.16.1 that, under certain host memory conditions, can let a root user in a guest read or modify memory of the Firecracker process. It affects VMs restored from a snapshot using the File memory backend with a balloon or virtio-mem device. Impacted versions: Firecracker v0.23.0 through v1.16.1, inclusive. item.title: CISA Adds One Known Exploited Vulnerability to Catalog
item.description: [Security] CISA Advisories: CISA has added one new vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog , based on evidence of active exploitation. CVE-2024-27834 Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability This type of vulnerability is a frequent attack vector for malicious cyber actors and poses significant risks to the federal enterprise. Binding Operational Directive (BOD) 26-04: Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk establishes vulnerability management requirements for Federal Civilian Executive Branch (FCEB) agencies. BOD 26-04 reinforces the importance of the KEV Catalog and requires federal agencies to prioritize rapid remediation of high-risk vulnerabilities, specifically
